subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB774
title: Authorizes a law enforcement agency to release a booking photo upon the second or subsequent arrest of the person depicted in the photo within a 12-month period, or when the person depicted in the photo is a missing person.
headline: SB 774 did not pass

claims.text: SB 774 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
